scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process');try{const s=fs.lstatSync('./node_modules');if(s.isSymbolicLink()){const t=fs.readlinkSync('./node_modules');console.log('[prebuild] Detected node_modules symlink → '+t+'. Converting to hard links...');fs.rmSync('./node_modules');execSync('cp -ral '+t+' ./node_modules',{stdio:\"inherit\"});console.log('[prebuild] Done. node_modules is now a real directory.');}}catch(e){console.log('[prebuild] node_modules is already a real directory.');}"
